name: alfred-notion
description: Search, preview, create and capture Notion pages and databases in Alfred 6
author: izsk

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target=node --format=esm --minify-syntax --outfile workflow/bin/nt.mjs && bun scripts/build-workflow.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run fmt:check && bun run test
